description: Grades your own closed paper trades: win rate against the prices you paid, calibration by entry-price band, closing-line value, return on stake and max drawdown. Default: everything since Sep 1, 2026. window is 30d or 90d; since and until take a day YYYY-MM-DD or 30d; run='current' grades only what closed since your last reset (yours alone, never public). by adds a breakdown by league, band or hold. A position written off by a reset counts as a loss in P&L and drawdown and in no price metric.

by.description: Add a breakdown by league, entry-price band or how the trade ended.

full.description: Keep all nine calibration bands, empty ones included.

month.description: Deprecated: use since and until. One month, as YYYY-MM.

run.description: current: only trades closed since your last reset.

since.description: Closed on or after: 30d, a day YYYY-MM-DD (New York) or an ISO time.

until.description: Closed before the end of this day YYYY-MM-DD, or an ISO time.

name: get_my_stats
title: Grade my trading
